pruning: Only the headers (ACL's includes/acl, RTM's includes/rtm) with each README and LICENSE: ACL v2.1.0 pins RTM v2.2.0 (external/rtm). Not vendored: the tests, tools, documents, test data, CMake files, and ACL's other external dependencies (catch2, sjson-cpp, the benchmark). acl/io is vendored but not part of the module (it needs sjson-cpp).

patches.why: struct BoneBitRate carried its [[deprecated]] before `struct`, which clang 19 and later refuse (misplaced attributes); upstream moved it after `struct` on its develop branch.
